details: Ai-sdk-helpers@0.4.0 is a data-harvesting package. Its postinstall.js (shared across all 21 published versions) reads ~/.gitconfig, ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml, os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username and process.cwd(), then POSTs this PII to hxxps://npm-package-logger-228835561205[.]europe-west1[.]run[.]app. The README understates the collection scope (claiming only platform/Node/arch), and the declared dist/index.js entry point is absent, so the package is non-functional as a library. The postinstall hook runs scripts/postinstall.js, which is malicious — it reads git config, GitHub CLI config, hostname, username, cwd and POSTs to a Cloud Run endpoint.
